lines.match: Machamp wearing a modern jacket appears in three-star raids during event hours and may be Shiny.
lines.text: Machamp wearing a modern jacket appears in three-star raids on both event days and may be Shiny.
lines.reason: The official GO Wild Area: Global page marks Modern Jacket Machamp as Shiny-eligible in three-star raids; its published event schedule and Leek Duck confirm availability on both days (https://pokemongo.com/gowildarea/global).
